sum: Bharat Hemraj Gala filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE regarding a substantial acquisition of shares in Kshitij Polyline Limited. The filing marks the formal notification of acquisition intent or completion under SEBI's Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers (SAST) Regulations.
detail: Bharat Hemraj Gala submitted the Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE on or around 19 June 2026, signalling a substantial acquisition in Kshitij Polyline Limited. Under SEBI SAST Regulations 2011, this disclosure is the mandatory first public notice when an acquirer crosses certain shareholding thresholds (typically 25% in an acquisition context). The filing establishes the legal framework and timeline for board approval, shareholder notification, and potential open offer mechanics. The specific acquisition value, percentage stake acquired, and deal structure are not disclosed in the available public record and require access to the full Form of Disclosure.
